create or alter function [dbo].[GetAssetTypeTextPathById] ( @Id int, @delimiter nvarchar(5) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( with c as ( select I.SubjectAssetTypeID as ParentID, I.ObjectAssetTypeID, cast(T.Name as nvarchar(2500)) as [Path], 1 as [Level] from AssetType T left join IntersectType I on I.ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID and (I.ObjectAssetTypeID <> I.SubjectAssetTypeID) and I.PredicateID in (select ID from [Predicate] where Type = 3) where T.ID = @Id
union all select I.SubjectAssetTypeID as ParentID, T.ID as ObjectAssetTypeID, cast(T.Name + @delimiter + C.[Path] as nvarchar(2500)) as [Path], C.Level + 1 as Level from AssetType T inner join c on T.ID = c.ParentID outer apply ( select SubjectAssetTypeID from IntersectType where ObjectAssetTypeID = T.ID and PredicateID in (select ID from [Predicate] where Type = 3) ) I )
select top 1 @Id as ID, [Path] from c order by Level desc )
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetTextPathById] ( @Id bigint, @delimiter nvarchar(5) ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( with c2 as ( select T.ID as AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, T.Object as AssetObject, T.ObjectID as AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue, 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P where T.ID = @Id union all select c2.AssetID, P.ID as ParentID, c2.AssetObject, c2.AssetObjectID, T.ID, T.Object, T.ObjectID, D.DisplayValue + @delimiter + c2.DisplayValue as DisplayValue, c2.Level + 1 as Level from Asset T outer apply dbo.GetAssetDisplayValueById(T.ID) D outer apply dbo.GetParentByAssetID(T.ID) P inner join c2 on c2.ParentID = T.ID )
select top 1 AssetID as ID, AssetObject as Object, AssetObjectID as ObjectID, DisplayValue as TextPath, Level from c2 order by Level desc )
